$comment: How a Figma component is recognised as final (ready to be built into the kit). Agreed with design on 2026-10-22: the designer sets `Статус: stable` in the component description. Everything else (beta, …) is a draft. `deprecated`: the component is being renamed or removed in Figma; the kit keeps the old name per README «Устаревание API» (agreed with design 2026-10-23).
